dedupeText: mid century soul duet album cover 1960s soul music duet vintage typography mid century modern portrait photography album art diagonal alignment of the two subjects creating depth horizontal color blocked header separating text from image contrast between decorative serif title and bold sans serif subtitle warm earth tones in clothing against a cool blue accent combine a subject duo in 1960s fashion with a split color header featuring ornamental serif title and condensed sans serif subtitle for a vintage soul aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style album cover featuring a dual portrait with a split-color header and decorative display typography.
triggerTerms: retro serif display type with sans-serif subtitle
excludeWhen: grunge or distressed textures are the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of a male and female duo, positioned diagonally, set against a neutral off-white background with a distinct horizontal header section containing two tiers of contrasting typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal alignment of the two subjects creating depth
Horizontal color-blocked header separating text from image
Contrast between decorative serif title and bold sans-serif subtitle
Warm earth tones in clothing against a cool blue accent
coreInvariants: Stacked text layout in the upper right quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects occupy the lower two-thirds, with the female figure in the foreground and the male figure slightly behind and to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The female subject's face and bright blue dress serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the decorative title at the top right, down through the names, following the diagonal line of the subjects' heads.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper left and right corners provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Brown and black for the male subject's attire
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright sky blue and lime green
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, warm mid-tones in the skin and clothing contrasted by high-saturation accents in the text and dress.

letterConstructionRules: Title uses a decorative serif with internal ornamental details
Subtitle uses a condensed, heavy-weight sans-serif
All-caps for both primary text elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: Internal vertical hatching or decorative dots within the title glyphs
Tight letter spacing in the sans-serif subtitle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Decorative ornamental serif paired with a functional, heavy condensed sans-serif for high contrast.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule separating the header
Small rectangular 'Stereo' banner at the very top

preserve: The specific green/blue color contrast in text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ornamental, Victorian-revival style of the title
Captures the heavy, mid-century sans-serif feel of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a brown suit and a woman in a blue dress with a silver collar, positioned diagonally against a cream background. Leave the top 25% of the frame as empty cream space with a thin green horizontal line across the middle of that space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the main title in a green ornamental serif font in the top right quadrant above the line. Place the artist names in a bold condensed blue sans-serif font directly below the line, aligned to the right.

verificationChecks: Is there a horizontal green line separating the two text blocks?
Is the color palette limited to cream, brown, blue, and green?

adjustableVariables: Exact wording of the title and subtitle

avoid: Contemporary font choices like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Check for correct diagonal subject composition
Ensure the green line is perfectly horizontal
Verify the decorative nature of the top font
Confirm the background is a warm off-white, not pure white
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Subject Duo] in [1960s Fashion] with a [Split-Color Header] featuring [Ornamental Serif Title] and [Condensed Sans-Serif Subtitle] for a vintage soul aesthetic.
